$comment: Derived from the codebase at src/App.jsx, src/pages/*, src/components/* and src/content/*. Route counts for the two dynamic templates come from the length of the exported data arrays (products.js = 3, posts.js = 7), not from a router manifest.

meta.source: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 rebuild of orchestra.bio
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder, read from source rather than a crawl

categories.CHROME: Layout-level furniture rendered by App.jsx for every route, outside the page component.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that establishes what the route is about.
categories.SHOWCASE: Product imagery and motion: screenshots, video, and the animated timeline strip.
categories.NARRATIVE: Sequential explanatory blocks that carry a page's argument.
categories.COLLECTION: Blocks that list other routes — post grids, related links.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to get the visitor to act.

chrome.navbar.description: Fixed 88px ink bar: wordmark, Product/Company/Blog links with carets on the first two, Login, and a Contact pill. The item matching the current route gets a solid pill behind it.
chrome.navbar.scope: Rendered by the shared Layout on all 15 routes, including the catch-all.

chrome.footer.description: Ink footer below the CTA: wordmark, mission line, mail link, Company and Product link columns, copyright row and social marks.
chrome.footer.scope: Rendered by the shared Layout on all 15 routes, including the catch-all.

conversion.cta-band.description: "Get started today" band: mono eyebrow, 76px headline, subhead and a mint Book a demo pill, over a full-bleed photo layer.
conversion.cta-band.scope: Rendered once, as the first child of Footer, so it reaches all 15 routes. Page components must not render it themselves.

hero.home.description: Centred ink hero: 76px two-line headline, single-line subhead and a light Book a demo pill.

hero.product.description: Left-aligned ink hero carrying the product's eyebrow, 56px title, subhead and a light Book a demo pill.

hero.about.description: Centred ink hero with an About eyebrow and a 64px mission statement, no call to action.

hero.contact.description: Paper band pairing a 40px "Get in Touch" heading and intro line with a full-height image on the right.

hero.blog-featured.description: Ink band promoting one post: cover image beside its title, excerpt and a Learn more link.

hero.post.description: Centred paper header: read-time line, article title, optional excerpt, then a full-width cover image.

hero.not-found.description: Ink 404 block: numeric eyebrow, apology headline and a link back to the home route.

showcase.hero-timeline.description: Animated 75px strip under the home hero: a looping horizontal track of lane-positioned pills, ring markers and labelled status chips.

showcase.product-frame.description: Full-bleed product screenshot with the interface video playing inset inside its frame, gated to play only while on screen.

showcase.system-video.description: Paper band with a 48px heading above a full-bleed looping video of the management system.

narrative.pillar-accordion.description: Fixed-height clipped band: a numbered pill menu, a 56px heading, and an auto-advancing two-item accordion whose active tab cross-fades the screenshot stack on the right.

narrative.product-feature.description: Repeating paper band pairing a numbered chip, 48px heading and body copy with a screenshot; each product route renders three.

narrative.approach.description: Two-column paper band stating the company's approach as a heading and a single paragraph.

narrative.intelligence-arc.description: Lead-in line followed by three numbered columns naming the stages of the product's intelligence arc.

narrative.team.description: Ink band of member pairs, each a portrait butted against a details panel carrying name, role and a LinkedIn link, followed by a full-width group photograph.

narrative.article-body.description: The article itself at an 800px measure, rendered from typed blocks: paragraph, heading, pull quote and captioned figure.
narrative.article-body.scope: All 7 blog post routes. Bodies are empty stubs, so this currently renders a placeholder.

collection.post-grid.description: Paper band listing every post except the featured one as a three-column grid of cover, title and Learn more link.

collection.related-posts.description: Two-column paper band offering two other posts at the foot of an article.

collection.home-updates.description: Ink "Latest updates" band showing three recent posts as cover-and-title cards.

conversion.contact-form.description: Four-field enquiry form — name, email, phone, free-text challenges — with a mint submit pill; posts nowhere and confirms in local state.

conversion.hiring.description: Paper band pairing a "We're hiring!" heading with two paragraphs and a button out to the external Ashby job board.
